record.text: I considered waking up early to watch today’s iPhone event, as it’s an important presentation for a couple of reasons – the first Apple Event with John Ternus as CEO, and the rumoured debut of the first foldable iPhone – but these aren’t important enough for me to wake up at 3 bloody AM. 🫩🇦🇺
I don't see the need for a 2K$-3K$ foldable iphone unless there is some magic feature they have kept secret.
The hidden purpose of the foldable iPhone, expected to start at $2200, is to reset Apple’s price anchoring and make the rest of their iPhone lineup look like a comparatively great value.
